title: If your router had someone else's root shell, updating while keeping settings does not clean it; GL.iNet proposes that after the attack through GoodCloud
content_md:
If your router had an unfamiliar root shell, updating it while keeping the existing settings does not clean the device. GL.iNet is proposing that approach after the attack carried out through its GoodCloud management service.

via Mastodon https://asturia.es/blog/2026-11-24-gl-inet-y-goodcloud-cuando-la-nube-de-gestion-es-la-puerta
